build_training_parser: build an argparse parser for training a MetaSeq model with dataset, optimization, and checkpoint args
build_generation_parser: build an argparse parser for generating text with a MetaSeq model using generation and checkpoint args
build_eval_lm_parser: build an argparse parser for evaluating a language model with dataset and LM evaluation args
parse_args_and_arch: parse command-line arguments and apply model architecture-specific configuration using a two-pass parsing strategy
build_validation_parser: build an argparse parser for validating a MetaSeq model with dataset and evaluation args
